name: ADIP Assistive Devices Support
detail: Aids and appliances for eligible persons with disabilities, including hearing aids and mobility devices.
amount: Up to Rs 15,000 per device cycle

name: NSAP Disability Pension Support
detail: Monthly income support for adults with benchmark disability living below the income ceiling.

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Students with Disabilities
detail: Education support for school-age students with disabilities.

name: Post-Matric Disability Scholarship
detail: College and vocational education support for young adults with disabilities.

name: Niramaya Health Insurance
detail: Health insurance cover for persons with specified disabilities, including therapy and hospitalisation.
amount: Cover up to Rs 1,00,000 per year

name: Maharashtra UDID Facilitation Support
detail: State facilitation for Unique Disability ID enrolment and local scheme bridging in Maharashtra.

name: Accessible India Skill Training Stipend
detail: Stipend for job-oriented skill training for working-age persons with disabilities.

name: Senior Disability Care Assistance
detail: Home-based care and caregiver support for older persons with disabilities.
